name: ask-my-docs
description: Monorepo root for Ask-My-Docs. Run `npm install` here once -- backend/ and frontend/ share the single root node_modules via npm workspaces. Do NOT run npm install inside backend/ or frontend/ directly; app dependencies belong in their workspace manifests. Root-only development tooling belongs here.

scripts.dev:all: concurrently --kill-others --names frontend,backend,ai-research --prefix-colors cyan,green,magenta "npm:frontend" "npm:backend" "cd ai-research && python main.py"
scripts.setup: npm install && python -m pip install -r requirements.txt
